steps.text: DirectX 12, so D3DMetal. Advertising AVX to the game is set because on an M4 Max (highball-db#48) the game crashed a few seconds after launch at the same code addresses on DXVK and on D3DMetal, which points at a startup check rather than the renderer, and a CPU feature the game assumes is the usual cause of that pattern under Rosetta. Unverified until the reporter confirms.

knownIssues.symptom: Crashes a few seconds after launch, before any rendering, at the same addresses whatever the graphics mode (reported on an M4 Max, macOS 15.7.7)
knownIssues.cause: not measured; a startup check is the likely class, AVX the usual suspect under Rosetta
knownIssues.fix: unverified: advertise AVX to the game (the recipe sets ROSETTA_ADVERTISE_AVX=1)
